one_liner: MrScraper is a web scraping platform with a REST API using self-serve API tokens (x-api-token), a free tier, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses a dashboard-generated token sent in the x-api-token header. Marketplace endpoints take the same token as a Bearer. OAuth 2.1 exists only on the hosted MCP server, not on the REST API, so it is not listed as an API auth method.
access_notes: The free plan needs no credit card and includes monthly tokens. The sources disagree on the allocation: 1,000 tokens on the pricing and blog pages, 100 tokens in the billing docs. Pro costs $199/mo.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Each user creates their own API token, and there is no OAuth for the REST API. The free tier's token quota is small.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the `x-api-token` HTTP header on every request
The hosted server supports browser sign-in through OAuth 2.1.
Scraper Free**: $0/mo (1,000 Plan Tokens/month at up to 10 concurrent requests, no credit card required).
The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
MrScraper MCP is the official [MrScraper](https://mrscraper.com) server for the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io).
